mathematical_corrections.issue: Printed proof infers boundedness of a continuous potential on a bounded positive-mass set; bounded sets need not be compact.
mathematical_corrections.correction: For positivity at fixed y, choose u* in supp(mu0) intersect X-prime, which has full measure in the separable Banach setup; continuity bounds Phi on a spatial neighborhood and the support-point property makes it positive mass. For a common lower evidence bound across a bounded data ball, use continuity at data center 0 to bound Phi(u;0) on a bounded positive-mass neighborhood, then the stated data-Lipschitz inequality and monotonicity of M2 extend this bound uniformly across that bounded data ball. This repairs the printed inference without assuming bounded sets are compact.

mathematical_corrections.source: Blechschmidt et al., Eq. (9)-(11), PDF pp. 7-8
mathematical_corrections.issue: Global Lipschitz continuity in state alone gives unique solutions and Lipschitz dependence, but not a C1 flow/diffeomorphism or classical Jacobian-divergence density formula.
mathematical_corrections.correction: For the C1 flow and classical formula require state differentiability with suitable derivative regularity (e.g. continuous spatial derivative on the finite interval); otherwise use an appropriate a.e./Sobolev flow theory. The specific smooth neural network may meet stronger assumptions, but the source statement is insufficient as a general contract.
